comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record captures twelve-cell distributed spring preload using a pressure plate and cross-key.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate aligns and latches a long telescoping rail, then drives screws; record simultaneously compresses many springs and transfers preload to a separate retaining key.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks rack registration and rail retention; record checks twelve individual contacts, compression ranges, key seating, clearance, and 1 s stability.
comparison.reason: Spring force is shared only at a generic level; distributed preload transfer is not rail latching. Candidate lacks calibrated spring and overload limits.
